messages:
ana (partnerships): Quick preflight: Azure Marketplace listing. Target soft launch ~2w. Need owners for manifest, pricing, legal, promo assets.
liam (cloud-partner): I'll own Azure contact and ask for a staging OfferID once we have a corrected manifest.
priya (product): Recommend SaaS listing. I'll draft pricing tiers (dev/standard/enterprise) and a token->billing unit map.
tom (ops): We'll provide minimal ARM template, /health, and sample metering webhook. Can produce staging bundle EOD.
marketplace-bot: manifest.json -> error: plan["standard"] missing billingPlanId. Add usageDimension and planId per tier.
vera (legal): I'll review publisher agreement and add a GDPR/data residency clause. Upload MSA draft shortly.
ana (partnerships) correction: ana: Timeline: today manifest fixes + staging bundle; tomorrow legal review; sync 9:30am PT. Owners: ana, liam, priya, tom, vera.
priya (product): PR will include description, screenshots, price table and conversion rules. Tagging reviewers.
liam (cloud-partner): Azure also requests promo images (1024x) and supportEmail in publisher metadata.
marketplace-bot: manifest lint: warning promotionalImages/1024x.png missing.
tom (ops): I'll add support@redwood-inference.com and a stub payload for metering. ETA 6pm PT.
vera (legal): Please comment on MSA in Drive by noon tomorrow. I'll add DSAR contact and retention policy.
